# How tea-sdlc works

<!-- Generated by scripts/map.py from the plugin sources. Do not edit; run `python3 scripts/map.py`. -->

tea-sdlc starts only from a slash command. No prompt keyword starts anything, and the model cannot load a tea-sdlc skill on its own. Inside a command, each stage is a fixed file and support skills are chosen from the repository's files.

## The lifecycle

```text
/tea-sdlc:aidlc <request or pasted spec>     (or each stage on its own)
  spec     spec.md: stories, decisions, Security, seams      ── one approval (skipped: ready-for-agent)
  plan     tickets.md: vertical slices                        gate: every story covered
  build    TDD at the seams, ticket by ticket                 gate: failing test before code
  verify   full suite at this code, stories traced           gate: aidlc verify green
  review   Spec + Standards axes, QA                          gate: PR create
  ship     PR, CI green, ship.md                             gate: PR merge
questions on the way: files → Atlassian Rovo → recorded assumption → (rarely) you
```

## Situation → command → what it loads

| Situation | Command | Loads, in order |
|---|---|---|
| New backend feature or behaviour change (a request or a pasted to-spec spec) | `/tea-sdlc:aidlc` | `spec` → `plan` → `build` → `verify` → `review` → `ship` |
| Open decisions; interview me before the spec | `/tea-sdlc:grilling` | — |
| Stage 1: spec.md, security, the one approval | `/tea-sdlc:spec` | `fintech-security` |
| Stage 2: tickets (vertical slices) | `/tea-sdlc:plan` | — |
| Stage 3: build the tickets test-first | `/tea-sdlc:build` | `test-driven-development` → `systematic-debugging` |
| Stage 4: full suite, trace, placeholders → verified | `/tea-sdlc:verify` | — |
| Stage 5: Spec + Standards review and QA → reviewed | `/tea-sdlc:review` | — |
| Stage 6: PR, CI, ship.md → shipped (merge on request) | `/tea-sdlc:ship` | — |
| Bug fix or small change with no new decision | `/tea-sdlc:fix` | `systematic-debugging` → `test-driven-development` → `verify` → `review` → `ship` |
| Review comments arrived | `/tea-sdlc:receiving-code-review` | `test-driven-development` → `verify` |
| Challenge a plan or a belief | `/tea-sdlc:reframe` | — |
| What a top practitioner would do | `/tea-sdlc:expert-lens` | — |
| Score, upgrade or A/B-duel one part of the plugin or a .claude directory | `/tea-sdlc:eval-upgrade` | — |
| A service has no living docs yet | `/tea-sdlc:generate-service-docs` | — |
| Turn a rough idea into an input that meets the AIDLC standard (checked with aidlc lint) | `/tea-sdlc:prompt-builder` | — |
| After the merge: promote the spec into the living docs, close it | `/tea-sdlc:upgrade-service-docs` | — |

## Support skills (never invoked by name)

| Skill | Read when |
|---|---|
| `test-driven-development` | build, fix: before any production code |
| `systematic-debugging` | fix; build when a test fails for an unexplained reason or a fix fails twice |
| `grounding-claims` | every stage: before a factual claim |
| `find-docs` | every stage: before relying on a library or cloud-service detail |
| `fintech-security` | spec and fix: when the trust-boundary check says yes |
| `backend-languages` | build.gradle, pom.xml, go.mod, Cargo.toml or a Python web framework |
| `database-patterns` | SQL migrations, ORM entities, DynamoDB or Redis clients |
| `messaging-patterns` | Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS or EventBridge clients, an outbox table |
| `api-contract-testing` | OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, proto files or Pact |
| `bdd-cucumber` | *.feature files, Cucumber or godog |
| `cdk-testing` | cdk.json |
| `observability` | dd-trace, dd-java-agent or DogStatsD dependencies |
| `session-bootstrap` | injected at every session start by hooks/session-start |

## Agents

| Agent | Job |
|---|---|
| `tea-sdlc:backend-engineer-subagent` (sonnet) | Implement server APIs, business logic, integrations, database changes and LLM features (prompts, RAG, agent … |
| `tea-sdlc:code-reviewer` (sonnet) | Review completed changes against requirements, contracts and coding standards, on the axis the dispatch names … |
| `tea-sdlc:qa-subagent` (sonnet) | In the review stage (spec at `verified`), validate every requirement ID through tickets.md and the aidlc … |
| `tea-sdlc:security-engineer-subagent` (sonnet) | Before trust-boundary implementation, assess authentication, permissions, sensitive data, payments, external … |

## Gates (on in every session)

| Hook | Fires on | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `hooks/session-start` | SessionStart | injects the command list and the stage + next command of every open spec |
| `hooks/autopilot.py` | SubagentStart | the rules every dispatched subagent follows |
| `hooks/autopilot.py` | Stop | code changed since the last test run → run the tests (once per change set) |
| `hooks/tdd-gate.py` | Edit / Write | first production edit needs a failing test run first (asks once) |
| `hooks/contract-gate.py` | Edit / Write / Bash | external API contract must pass check-contract.py (advisory) |
| `hooks/question-gate.py` | AskUserQuestion | inside a tea-sdlc command: blocked when the input delegated every decision; otherwise the first question before any Rovo search is sent back |
| `hooks/security-gate.py` | git commit / push | blocked while gitleaks finds a secret |
| `hooks/pr-review-gate.py` | opening a PR | blocked until the pre-PR review is recorded for HEAD with 0 open findings |
| `hooks/ship-gate.py` | merging a PR | blocked until the branch's spec passes the `shipped` gate |

## Files one feature leaves behind

| File | Read it? | What |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/specs/<feature>/spec.md` | yes | what and why: stories, decisions, security, seams, sources |
| `docs/specs/<feature>/tickets.md` | when planning | the slices and their order |
| `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/adr/` | when a term or decision is unclear | domain words; hard-to-reverse choices |
| the pull request | yes | the change, the threats checked, the review |
| `README.md`, `ledger.md`, `review.md`, `ship.md` in the spec folder | no | evidence the gates check |

## Words

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Command | the only way tea-sdlc starts: `/tea-sdlc:<name>`. Every skill has `disable-model-invocation: true`. |
| AIDLC | proposed → accepted → planned → building → verified → reviewed → shipped → implemented; `scripts/aidlc.py advance` moves a stage only when its gate passes. |
| Trust boundary | PII or money, auth/session/permissions, a new public endpoint, a new vendor, secrets or security config. Unsure counts as yes. |
| Rovo first | a business question goes to files, then Atlassian Rovo, then a recorded assumption; a person only for risk, money/regulatory, irreversible or contradictory cases (`references/aidlc.md` §0). |
| spec.md | the to-spec template: Problem, Solution, numbered User Stories, Implementation Decisions (incl. Security), Testing Decisions, Out of Scope, Further Notes (Sources, Assumptions). |
| Story ID | user story n of a spec with `key: RFD` is `RFD-n`; tests name it so `aidlc trace` can find them. |
| Ticket | one tracer-bullet vertical slice in tickets.md, with Blocked by, Covers and acceptance checkboxes. |
| Seam | the public interface tests go through; the fewer the better, agreed in Testing Decisions. |
| Gate | a hook or `aidlc` check that blocks the next step until its evidence exists. |

Exact rules: `rules/workflow-routing.md` (fix or aidlc, trust boundary, stack skills), `references/aidlc.md` (questions, lifecycle formats and gates), `skills/session-bootstrap/SKILL.md`.
